title: Dynamic Analysis and Optimal Prevention Strategies for Monkeypox Spread Modeled via the Mittag--Leffler Kernel
summary: Monkeypox is a viral disease belonging to the smallpox family. Although it has milder symptoms than smallpox in humans, it has become a global threat in recent years, especially in African countries. Initially, incidental immunity against monkeypox was provided by smallpox vaccines. However, the eradication of smallpox over time and thus the lack of vaccination has led to the widespread and clinical importance of monkeypox.
